response.sql: SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proportion FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.status

assumptions.assumption: Events with a NULL status form their own group (shown with a NULL status) and count in the denominator, since the request says 'over all statuses'. If no event has a NULL status, this changes nothing.
The ratio is a fraction between 0 and 1, not a percentage. It is computed with real division so integer division does not truncate it.
